title: The copy draft is written in eight parts, and a finished picture round records where its time went
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The chain's copy parts are a value the writer takes, below its ceiling.
A finished picture round records its round times as whole milliseconds and its frame task count.

tests: the copy step's first draft is written in parts the writer takes, below its ceiling
a finished round records where its time went: whole milliseconds, and how many frame tasks it ran
